en.title: Unrestricted IPv4 permit
en.finding: A reachable rule permits all IPv4 protocols from any source to any destination.
en.reason: This is a permit-by-default boundary and can expose traffic not explicitly required.
en.recommendation: Replace it with the minimum required sources, destinations and protocols after validating traffic requirements.
en.fieldExperienceNote: Direction and attachment context are not available; confirm the policy placement before changing it.

zh.title: 无限制 IPv4 放行
zh.finding: 发现一条可达规则，允许任意源到任意目的的全部 IPv4 协议。
zh.reason: 该规则形成默认放行边界，可能暴露未明确需要的流量。
zh.recommendation: 核实业务需求后，将其收紧到最小必要的源、目的和协议。
zh.fieldExperienceNote: 当前没有方向和挂载点上下文，变更前必须确认策略部署位置。

references.title: NIST SP 800-41 Rev. 1 — Guidelines on Firewalls and Firewall Policy

en.title: Unrestricted TCP permit
en.finding: A reachable rule permits all TCP traffic between any source and destination without a destination-port limit.
en.reason: The rule is broader than a service-specific allowlist.
en.recommendation: Restrict source, destination and destination port to the documented application flow.
en.fieldExperienceNote: A broad TCP rule may be intentional for a trusted transit boundary; verify direction and zone context.

zh.title: 无限制 TCP 放行
zh.finding: 发现一条可达规则，允许任意源到任意目的的全部 TCP 流量，且未限制目的端口。
zh.reason: 该规则比面向具体服务的允许列表更宽。
zh.recommendation: 按已确认的应用流量限制源、目的和目的端口。
zh.fieldExperienceNote: 可信中转边界可能有意使用宽泛规则，需核实方向和安全域。

en.title: Unrestricted UDP permit
en.finding: A reachable rule permits all UDP traffic between any source and destination without a destination-port limit.
en.reason: The rule admits more services than an explicit allowlist.
en.recommendation: Limit it to required endpoints and UDP services.
en.fieldExperienceNote: Validate application discovery and return-traffic behavior before narrowing the rule.

zh.title: 无限制 UDP 放行
zh.finding: 发现一条可达规则，允许任意源到任意目的的全部 UDP 流量，且未限制目的端口。
zh.reason: 该规则允许的服务范围超过明确允许列表。
zh.recommendation: 限制到必要端点和 UDP 服务。
zh.fieldExperienceNote: 收紧前需核实应用发现和返回流量行为。

en.title: Reachable Telnet permit
en.finding: A reachable TCP permit targets destination port 23 (Telnet).
en.reason: Telnet does not provide the authentication and transport protection expected for secure remote administration.
en.recommendation: Remove the Telnet path or replace it with an approved encrypted management method such as SSH.
en.fieldExperienceNote: The port is a protocol indicator, not proof of the application; verify the actual service before remediation.

zh.title: 可达的 Telnet 放行
zh.finding: 发现一条可达 TCP 放行规则，目的端口为 23（Telnet）。
zh.reason: Telnet 不具备安全远程管理所需的认证与传输保护。
zh.recommendation: 移除 Telnet 路径，或改用经批准的加密管理方式，例如 SSH。
zh.fieldExperienceNote: 端口只能提示协议，不能证明实际应用；整改前应核实服务。

references.title: NIST IR 7966 — Security of SSH Access Management
IANA Service Name and Port Number Registry

en.title: SSH permitted from any source
en.finding: A reachable TCP/22 permit accepts any source.
en.reason: Privileged remote access should be restricted to authorized management paths.
en.recommendation: Limit SSH sources to approved management networks or access points.
en.fieldExperienceNote: Any source may still be constrained elsewhere; confirm upstream controls and attachment direction.

zh.title: SSH 允许任意源访问
zh.finding: 发现一条可达 TCP/22 放行规则，源地址为任意。
zh.reason: 特权远程访问应限制在获授权的管理路径。
zh.recommendation: 将 SSH 源限制到批准的管理网段或访问控制点。
zh.fieldExperienceNote: 上游可能已有约束，需确认其他控制措施和挂载方向。

references.title: IANA Service Name and Port Number Registry

en.title: SNMP permitted from any source
en.finding: A reachable UDP/161 permit accepts any source.
en.reason: Management-plane polling should be limited to authorized management systems.
en.recommendation: Restrict the source to approved monitoring networks and verify the SNMP security version separately.
en.fieldExperienceNote: ACL syntax cannot determine the SNMP version, credentials or upstream protections.

zh.title: SNMP 允许任意源访问
zh.finding: 发现一条可达 UDP/161 放行规则，源地址为任意。
zh.reason: 管理面轮询应仅允许获授权的监控系统。
zh.recommendation: 将源限制到批准的监控网段，并单独核实 SNMP 安全版本。
zh.fieldExperienceNote: 仅凭 ACL 无法判断 SNMP 版本、凭据和上游保护。

references.title: CISA Enhanced Visibility and Hardening Guidance
IANA Service Name and Port Number Registry

en.title: Rule shadowed by an earlier match
en.finding: An earlier rule fully contains a later rule, so first-match evaluation prevents the later rule from taking effect.
en.reason: The later action cannot be reached for its declared traffic set.
en.recommendation: Review intent and reorder, narrow or remove the affected rule.
en.fieldExperienceNote: Validate hit counters and deployment context before changing rule order.

zh.title: 规则被前序匹配遮蔽
zh.finding: 前序规则完整包含后续规则，首次匹配机制使后续规则无法生效。
zh.reason: 后续动作对其声明的流量集合不可达。
zh.recommendation: 核实意图后调整顺序、收紧或删除受影响规则。
zh.fieldExperienceNote: 调整顺序前应核实命中计数和部署上下文。

references.title: Cisco IOS IP Access List Overview
Juniper — How Firewall Filters Are Evaluated

en.title: Duplicate ACL rule
en.finding: A later rule duplicates an earlier match and action.
en.reason: The duplicate adds maintenance noise without changing first-match behavior.
en.recommendation: Confirm counters and references, then remove the redundant entry if safe.
en.fieldExperienceNote: Duplicate entries may temporarily support change procedures; confirm operational intent.

zh.title: 重复 ACL 规则
zh.finding: 后续规则与前序规则的匹配条件和动作完全重复。
zh.reason: 重复项不会改变首次匹配结果，但会增加维护噪声。
zh.recommendation: 核实计数和引用后，在安全的情况下删除冗余项。
zh.fieldExperienceNote: 重复项可能用于临时变更流程，需确认运维意图。

references.title: Cisco IOS IP Access List Overview

en.title: ACL contains no permit rule
en.finding: The parsed ACL contains deny rules but no permit rule.
en.reason: For traffic-filtering ACL semantics, unmatched traffic is implicitly denied, so this policy permits no represented traffic.
en.recommendation: Confirm whether a block-all policy is intended; otherwise add only the explicitly required permits.
en.fieldExperienceNote: Some features use ACLs as match selectors rather than forwarding policy; verify the attachment context.

zh.title: ACL 不包含放行规则
zh.finding: 已解析 ACL 只有拒绝规则，没有放行规则。
zh.reason: 在流量过滤语义下，未匹配流量还会被隐式拒绝，因此该策略不放行已表示的任何流量。
zh.recommendation: 确认是否有意全部阻断；否则仅增加明确需要的放行项。
zh.fieldExperienceNote: 部分功能把 ACL 用作匹配选择器而非转发策略，必须核实挂载场景。

references.title: Cisco IOS IP Access List Overview

en.title: Deny-all rule precedes later entries
en.finding: An explicit deny-all rule appears before the end of the ACL.
en.reason: First-match evaluation makes every later entry unreachable.
en.recommendation: Move the deny-all rule to the intended terminal position or remove unreachable entries after validating policy intent.
en.fieldExperienceNote: Preserve required logging and change-control sequencing when moving a terminal rule.

zh.title: 全部拒绝规则位于后续项之前
zh.finding: 显式全部拒绝规则出现在 ACL 末尾之前。
zh.reason: 首次匹配机制使其后的所有规则不可达。
zh.recommendation: 核实策略意图后，将全部拒绝规则移至预期末尾，或删除不可达项。
zh.fieldExperienceNote: 移动终止规则时需保留必要日志并遵守变更流程。

references.title: Cisco IOS IP Access List Overview
Juniper — How Firewall Filters Are Evaluated
